engineeringSkip.reason: Neutron-degenerate matter is only stable inside neutron stars under crushing gravity; 'neutronium lattice' materials with artificial gravitational compression and strong-force stabilization have no basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: Neutron-degenerate matter only exists inside neutron stars, where gravity holds it together; no known physics lets anyone manufacture it in a lab as a material or use it as an anchor.
